mapper.sql: c.id::text,c.up_id::text AS parent_id,c.cd AS code,c.nm AS name,c.expln AS description,c.actvtn_yn AS active,c.sort_seq AS ordinal,c.lck_ver_no AS lock_version, ((SELECT count(*) FROM catalog.dataset_revision r JOIN catalog.dataset d ON d.id=r.dtset_id JOIN identity.organization owner ON owner.id=d.psn_inst_id WHERE (r.main_clsf_id=c.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog.revision_topic rt WHERE rt.rvsn_id=r.id AND rt.tpc_id=c.id)) AND owner.stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND d.psn_inst_id IN CAST(#{organization} AS uuid) AND false ) +(SELECT count(*) FROM classification.category child WHERE child.up_id=c.id)) AS usage_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM classification.category c ORDER BY c.sort_seq,c.cd LIMIT 1000
SELECT FROM classification.category c WHERE c.id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classification.category(id,up_id,cd,nm,expln,actvtn_yn,sort_seq) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS uuid),CAST(#{parentId} AS uuid),#{code},#{name},#{description},#{active},#{ordinal})
mapper.update: UPDATE classification.category SET nm=#{name},expln=#{description},actvtn_yn=#{active},sort_seq=#{ordinal},lck_ver_no=lck_ver_no+1,mdfcn_dt=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND lck_ver_no=#{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM classification.category WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND lck_ver_no=#{version}
mapper.sql:
FROM catalog.dataset d JOIN identity.organization owner ON owner.id=d.psn_inst_id JOIN catalog.dataset_revision r ON r.dtset_id=d.id JOIN classification.category category ON category.id=r.main_clsf_id WHERE owner.stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND (category.id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) OR category.up_id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog.revision_topic rt JOIN classification.category topic ON topic.id=rt.tpc_id WHERE rt.rvsn_id=r.id AND (topic.id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) OR topic.up_id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid))))
AND d.psn_inst_id IN CAST(#{organization} AS uuid) AND false
mapper.select: WITH matching AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(d.id) d.id AS dataset_id,r.id AS revision_id ORDER BY d.id,r.rvsn_no DESC) SELECT m.dataset_id::text,r.id::text AS revision_id,r.ttl AS title, coalesce(parent.nm,category.nm) AS field_name, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(rt.nm_snpst,', ' ORDER BY rt.nm_snpst,rt.tpc_id) FROM catalog.revision_topic rt WHERE rt.rvsn_id=r.id), CASE WHEN parent.id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE category.nm END) AS topic_name, provider.inst_nm AS provider_organization_name,r.rls_rng_cd AS visibility,r.stts_cd AS revision_state,p.stts_cd AS publication_state, r.rvsn_no AS revision_no,r.mdfcn_dt AS updated_at,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog.dataset_revision newer WHERE newer.dtset_id=m.dataset_id AND newer.rvsn_no>r.rvsn_no) AS current_revision FROM matching m JOIN catalog.dataset_revision r ON r.id=m.revision_id JOIN classification.category category ON category.id=r.main_clsf_id LEFT JOIN classification.category parent ON parent.id=category.up_id JOIN identity.organization provider ON provider.id=r.pvsn_inst_id LEFT JOIN catalog.publication p ON p.rvsn_id=r.id ORDER BY r.mdfcn_dt DESC,m.dataset_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
